summary: Independent review of task 21.2 (canonical documentation reconciliation for v1.2). I inspected the full diff, the six named current-state surfaces, the state update, and the worker report, and I re-ran both documentation gates myself rather than trusting the recorded results. The diff is 8 tracked files (GOALS.md, PLANS.md, README.md, docs/architecture/12, docs/limitations/{00-index,accepted,archive}.md, docs/plan/state.json) plus the new untracked docs/implementation/21.2/worker-report.json. No immutable-history path (docs/implementation/**, docs/reviews/**, docs/changelog/**, docs/plan/archive/**, ADR text, docs/research/**) was touched; `git diff HEAD --name-only` confirms this and no production or test code changed. Every claimed correction is genuinely correct and introduces no new stale claim or overclaim: GOALS.md's V1.2 pointer no longer says 'proposed pending acceptance' and its 'ADR-022 onward (accepted; Accepted (v1.2))' form is true against docs/decisions/00-index.md; the README and archive.md F1 lines now record task 14.3 as completed with the correct PASS evidence; the limitations index intro no longer describes the v1.2 additions as in flight; the architecture 12 'open limitation F3' label is now 'the formerly open limitation F3, resolved by Phase 17 task 17.4', which matches archive.md F3. I independently verified the V11-G4 rescope rather than accepting the worker's account: docs/architecture/00-index.md contains no '14.3' reference at all, so dropping it from the retain-list and asserting it no longer carries the framing is accurate, and the only remaining occurrences of 'owned by task 14.3' outside immutable history are in docs/plan/archive/**. F3/F4/F6/F7/F8 are Resolved in docs/limitations/archive.md with resolving phase/tasks, shipped behaviour, decision reference, evidence lists, and bounds; the index rows and docs/plan/state.json limitations.resolved agree; docs/limitations/open.md records none of them. F5 is Accepted in accepted.md with the explicit reclassified-from-Open disposition, is the row the index points to accepted.md for, is in state.json limitations.accepted, and its exclusion is recorded in docs/planning/v1.2.md section 10. The decisions index shows ADR-022..ADR-029 all Accepted (v1.2) with the ADR-029 amendment note on ADR-022 and the dependent extension/supersession notes on ADR-002/003/009/016/019/020. The state update follows the single-writer rule (worker writes task done/reports; the phase status, gate, and tag remain orchestrator-owned, and Phase 21 is still PLANNED, unchanged) and no generated block was hand-edited. I re-ran `scripts/check-docs.sh` with dotnet on PATH: nine ok sections and 'check-docs: PASS' on the tree with the worker report temporarily moved aside, and with the report in place the only two FAIL lines are the contract-mandated agent-pairing lines that close when this reviewer report is listed in state.json. `dotnet run scripts/render-docs-state.cs -- --check` reports 'status.md: up to date', 'PLANS.md: up to date', 'PLANS.md and state.json agree', exit 0. The reconciliation is complete for the six named surfaces: an old-value sweep over README.md, GOALS.md, docs/architecture/, docs/data-model/, docs/limitations/, docs/decisions/00-index.md, PLANS.md, and docs/status.md finds no remaining 'proposed', 'owned by task 14.3', 'remains open', 'not yet implemented', or 'as their phase tasks land' phrasing in a current-state surface, and spot-checks of the sections the worker claimed needed no change (architecture 04/06/08/09/11, data-model 03-06/03-08/03-12, README v1.2 capability text) confirm they already describe the shipped v1.2 behavior. Three residual observations are recorded as informational: the V11-G4 consequence sentence says only 'the immutable archived history under docs/plan/archive/' retains the phrasing, which is true of the current-state surfaces but not literally exhaustive (docs/changelog/v1.1.0.md also retains it, as immutable history on a different path); the planner-owned active-scope note in state.json and PLANS.md lines 20/65 still bound the v1.2 decision records at ADR-022..ADR-028, which is true but not exhaustive now that ADR-029 exists; and no per-task changelog entry was added to docs/changelog/v1.2.0.md, matching the boundary that assigns the release changelog to 21.6 and the precedent set by the twice-approved 21.1. None of these affects an acceptance criterion or a stated requirement, so none is required and none blocks.
